artifacts.summary: Confirms both defects at cited lines, finds a third latent bug (status enum mismatch between todo.md's derivation and state-schema.json's declared 4-value enum), confirms this repo itself has no Makefile/package.json (live proof the current probe is non-portable), confirms no consumer of the technical_debt frontmatter block exists in agent-system/extensions/**, and confirms skill-todo/SKILL.md has no repository-metrics stage to mirror into. Recommends reading (a) 'structurally sound' for build_errors via a cheap bash-n/jq-empty probe with a nullable 'not measured' schema extension (precedented by memory_health.last_distilled), and option (b) for Defect 2 (delete Step 5.7.3, state.json remains sole home for repository_health).

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, .opencode/ is a SEPARATE git-tracked deploy tree (not gitignored, not generated from agent-system/extensions/**), distinct from .claude/ (blanket-gitignored, generated from agent-system/extensions/** and byte-identical to source for skill files). When searching for 'real consumers' of a source-store artifact under the binding source-store rule, grep hits inside .opencode/ do not count as in-scope consumers.

state-schema.json already has a precedent for a nullable 'not measured' field: memory_health.last_distilled is typed ["string", "null"]. Reuse this union-type pattern (e.g. ["integer", "null"]) instead of inventing a new sentinel value when a metric can legitimately be unmeasured.

validate-state.sh and state-write.sh do NOT deep-validate field types/enums against state-schema.json -- validate-state.sh only checks top-level key presence and the 12-value task-status enum on active_projects[].status; state-write.sh only validates jq filter syntax. Nested object fields (e.g. repository_health.status's 4-value enum) can silently drift from the declared schema with nothing catching it. Worth checking before trusting that a schema-documented enum is actually enforced anywhere.
